About / Approach

Healthcare context.
Analytical discipline.

SQL · SNOWFLAKE · HEALTHCARE ANALYTICS

I’m Busayo Oyewole, a healthcare data analyst based in Severn, Maryland. At AssistRx, I develop SQL datasets, dashboards, and operational reporting using Snowflake, Salesforce, Tableau, and ThoughtSpot.

My experience spans patient fulfillment and onboarding, provider data, healthcare claims, clinical quality reporting, and reporting automation. I translate business requirements into validated datasets and clear reporting for clinical, operational, and executive teams.

Previously: Provider Data Analyst at Mass Advantage and Data Analyst at Kaiser Permanente. Education: M.S. in Data Analytics and B.S. in Health Services Management, University of Maryland Global Campus. Professional background is drawn from my resume; portfolio project findings remain synthetic.

Business impact

Designed for better decisions.

These are proposed applications, not verified employer outcomes. Add real results only when you can substantiate them.

01 / ACCESS

Make the backlog visible.

Separate pending referrals from closed cases and treatment starts. Give teams a common language for where work is waiting.

02 / TRUST

Explain every exclusion.

Keep raw records, label data defects, and reconcile the accepted shipment count before publishing a report.

03 / FLOW

Focus the next review.

Pair completed-case turnaround with unresolved-case aging. Investigate delay without hiding open work.
